text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And the one looking surprised is 
Verxina. Attending Tracen Academy just 
like her two older sisters, she is a cute, 
playfully devilish Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Miss Pandora, aren't you going to the 
festival today~!? All my big sisters said 
they're going, too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah, I get it♡ You have a fever♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nuh-uh! I'm totally serious about the 
Shuka Sho, so I'm gonna train!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you don't have a bit of a 
fever?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I told you, I don't~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She wants to get closer to her dream at 
the Shuka Sho. Fusaichi Pandora's 
determination... was for real!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This festival wasn't the only thing 
Fusaichi Pandora had been turning down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey! We're doing a test of courage 
tonight... You're coming too, right?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta get up early tomorrow, so I'll 
pass!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"During today's lunch break, we're all 
going to do a watermelon split. Would you 
like to join us, Pandora?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to review my form, so I'll 
pass!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—And that's why I've been turning down 
all kinds of invitations to hang out...!”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haaa...!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, no more, I can't. I'm done, not 
running, impossible. It's way too hot. 
This is bad.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I wanna go back to the cafeteria 
and eat shaved iceee...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Shuka Sho'. Everyone said they'd 
come watch, didn't they..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. ............Just a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Just a... little more!! Hrrraaagh!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: From here on oooout!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by her fiery enthusiasm, the 
days of the summer training camp flew by—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, with only a few days left of 
summer camp, it suddenly dawned on me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For someone who has worked this hard, 
could I prepare some kind of reward for 
her...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without getting in the way of her resolve, 
what is there that I can do...?
choice_data_list: Let's make dinner a lavish BBQ!

We'll set aside time to play at the beach 
after training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just hope Fusaichi Pandora enjoys 
herself...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: The abso-freaking-lute best——!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Out of nowhere you said we were eating out 
today, so I wondered what was up, but not 
bad, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Super tasty. Seriously the best. You did 
so good, you genius!
choice_data_list:
It's because you worked so hard at summer 
training camp, Pandora.

It's because you worked so hard at summer 
training camp, Pandora!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? So that's how it is, huh... 
Ahha♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh! If we're doing a BBQ, we gotta 
make that! Toasted marshmallows!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—I'll make it for you♡ After all, you're 
always lookin' out for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, with slightly clumsy hands, 
Fusaichi Pandora began roasting 
marshmallows—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Do this and then this? Um, how long 
does Papa usually grill it for~?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Oh no! It burnt! Wait, that took like 
two seconds...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“......Here you go♡ Thank you as always. 
Ehehe.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The marshmallow you toasted for me was a 
little bitter, but... even so, it was 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? 'Let's play at the beach before 
heading home today'? Why?
choice_data_list:
Since it's been nothing but training up to 
now.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Breathers and rewards shouldn't be 
overlooked when it comes to maintaining 
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that above all, she should 
treat herself and have a fun time. To 
which she replied—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ………… "Just have fun, no matter what"...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Okey-doke, gotcha♡ I'll be right back, 
then~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, a few minutes later.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aaaand here, a present for you♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
What's with that reaction~? Is it really 
that weird? You're the one who told me to 
do whatever I want!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't that fine? I got strawberry, 
so let's go over there and share them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, sitting side by side at the 
water's edge, we ate shaved ice together.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mmm, so good! Wait, aagh! Brain freeze!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "I'm nooot okay! Wahhh—!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hahaha! Whoa, your tongue is so 
blue, it's hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling relieved to see Fusaichi Pandora 
so relaxed... we spent a peaceful, 
heartwarming time together.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmh~~~! Ah, that was so fun♡ It feels like 
it's been forever since we did something 
like this~♪
choice_data_list:
...Thank you so much for all your hard 
work at summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "...Ahaha♡ Thanks a bunch♡"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, she's been trying pretty darn hard 
up until now too, right? Though this time, 
it's like, so waaaay beyond that~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's so freaking hot day after day. 
Sweating constantly and feeling completely 
sticky.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“Still... Just like Kuu-chan-senpai said, 
if you want your dream to come true, you 
can't give up!”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
From here on... I want to make history and 
become the most sparkling girl in the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That dream scenery I've been watching 
forever. Before my racing life comes to an 
end—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Even starting now, I will! I want to show 
everyone what I can do!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha! That really got me fired up! I'm 
gonna keep giving it my all starting 
tomorrow☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of it is for the Shuka Sho—to fulfill 
her ideals on that grand stage!
